name: Adhatoda vasica + Centella asiatica
indication_description:
This syrup is indicated in-
  • Cough
  • Dry Cough
  • Bronchitis
  • Chronic lung infection
  • Rhinitis
  • Flu & headache
pharmacology_description: Adhatoda vasica Contains alkaloid vasicine which has expectorant qualities so it is useful for bronchitis and other chest conditions of upper respiratory tract. The soothing action of vasac helps irritation in the throat and the expectorant action helps loosen phlegm deposits in the airway and expels it out. Honey reduces mucus secretion and cough.
dosage_description:
Children: 1/2-1 teaspoonful 2-3 times daily.
Adult: 2-4 teaspoonful 2-3 times daily.
Or as directed by the registered physician.
contraindications_description: It is contraindicated in patients known to have hypersensitivity to the drug or any of its components.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: The safety of the Syrup in pregnancy & lactation has not been established. Therefore, it should be used with caution during pregnancy & lactation.
storage_conditions_description: Keep out of reach of children. Keep away from direct sunlight. Store in a cool and dry place.
